name: io.github.Xquik-dev/tweetclaw
description: Search tweets, search replies, post tweets, export followers, manage media, monitor X/Twitter, and run giveaway draws through Xquik. OpenClaw plugin with 99 agent-callable endpoints via 2 tools (explore + tweetclaw). StreamableHTTP at xquik.com/mcp with API key auth.
